title: Reservation: number of people
prompt: How many people is the reservation for?
hint: Give the number of guests mentioned in the sentence (one or two words).

ja.hint: 本文に書かれた人数を1〜2語で答えてください。

local.hint: 用一到两个词回答句子中提到的人数。

local_pron.hint: Yòng yī dào liǎng gè cí huídá jùzi zhōng títào de rénshù.

zh.hint: 用一到两个词回答句子中提到的人数。

en.prompt: How many people is the reservation for?
en.hint: Give the number of guests mentioned in the sentence (one or two words).

en_pron.prompt: How many people is the reservation for?
en_pron.hint: Give the number of guests mentioned in the sentence (one or two words).

title: Reservation: time
hint: Answer as a short sentence stating the reservation time.

ja.prompt: 予約の時間は何時ですか？
ja.hint: 予約時間を示す短い文で答えてください。

local.hint: 用一句简短的句子说明预约时间。

local_pron.hint: Yòng yī jù jiǎnduǎn de jùzi shuōmíng yùdìng shíjiān.
local_pron.sample: Wǒ de yùdìng shì wǎnshang qī diǎn.

zh.hint: 用一句简短的句子说明预订时间。

en.hint: Answer as a short sentence stating the reservation time.

en_pron.hint: Answer as a short sentence stating the reservation time.
en_pron.sample: My reh-zur-VAY-shun is at seven pee-em.

title: Order: dishes
prompt: Which dishes did the speaker order?
hint: Name both specific dishes mentioned in the sentence.
sample: A Caesar salad and grilled salmon.

ja.prompt: 話し手はどの料理を注文しましたか？
ja.hint: 文中で挙げられた具体的な料理名を両方答えてください。
ja.sample: シーザーサラダとグリルサーモンです。

local.hint: 说出句子中提到的两个具体菜名。

local_pron.hint: Shuō chū jùzi zhōng tí dào de liǎng gè jùtǐ càimíng.

en.prompt: Which dishes did the speaker order?
